technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with stochrsi bounce signal present, but price structure remains bearish with all major moving averages above price and weak trend confirmation; high-risk reversal setup requiring confirmation.

fundamental.summary: IFF shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 14 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale and mixed with no recent conviction, and absent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (389.12), FOMC event today, and earnings in 14 days create severe macro headwinds for Materials sector trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) with StochRSI bullish cross and Supertrend signal in fear-driven market (VIX crisis) creates contrarian reversal setup near support at 117.53.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish Ichimoku structure, negative CMF, weak ADX trend confirmation, FOMC event today, earnings in 14 days, and no institutional/insider conviction make this a high-risk trap reversal in unfavorable macro.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) with StochRSI bullish cross presents technical reversal setup in fear-driven market; price at support (117.53) offers defined risk entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event today combined with earnings in 14 days creates binary event risk that can gap through support; bearish price structure (below all major MAs, negative CMF, weak ADX) suggests reversal trap rather than sustained bounce.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents see oversold bounce opportunity, but fundamental/risk/sentiment agents heavily weight macro headwinds and earnings proximity; debate decisively favors bear case (8 vs 4).
decision.portfolio_note: Zero sector concentration in Materials and no existing IFF position; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows full sizing, but macro environment and event risk do not justify entry at this conviction level.
